description: Parse turns websites into managed, callable structured APIs and provides tools to create, revise, export, and execute those APIs. It also offers a marketplace of pre-built APIs for public web data.
summary: Parse exposes a REST API at `https://api.parse.bot` with an OpenAPI spec, a remote MCP server at `https://api.parse.bot/mcp`, and a `parse` CLI distributed via PyPI (`parse-sdk`); auth is via Parse-issued API keys, with OAuth also supported for MCP and CLI login.
